source_text: Rex Gai in ligno gemino suspenditur — figura crucis. Hostium princeps triumphatur in ligno; Christus principatus exspolians in cruce. Forma regis suspensi advesperum deponitur — dispensationis tempus.
pass_a_gloss: King of-Ai on wood twin is-hung — figure of-cross. Of-enemies prince is-triumphed on wood; Christ principalities stripping on cross. Form of-king hung toward-evening is-taken-down — of-dispensation time.
pass_b_english: [[The king of Ai is hanged on a twin wood >> Bible:Joshua 8:29]] — a cross figure. The enemy prince is triumphed over on the tree; Christ [[disarms principalities on the cross >> Bible:Colossians 2:15]]. At evening the hanged form is taken down — the time of the economy.
